headword: {合同会社|ごうどうがいしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A type of company created by the 2006 Companies Act, cheaper and simpler to set up than a {株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}. The owners are also the managers and are liable only up to what they invested. Many small businesses use it, and so do the Japanese subsidiaries of some foreign firms, such as Apple Japan and Amazon Japan.

notes:
Often abbreviated (⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧) in company names, and called LLC in English.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合同会社|ごうどうがいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}する→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧: to establish an LLC
- {合同会社|ごうどうがいしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{代表社員|だいひょうしゃいん}: the representative member of an LLC (its head)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}→株式会社：19101_kabushikigaisha⟧: stock company, corporation; the usual form for larger firms
- ⟦{有限会社|ゆうげんがいしゃ}→有限会社：27499_yuugengaisha⟧: limited company, a form that can no longer be newly created since 2006

WATCH OUT:
Its members are called ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧ in law even though they are owners, not employees.
